CRLR No.167 of 2018 
With 
CRMA No.1039 of 2018 (Stay Application) 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. Sanjeev Singh, Advocate for 
the revisionist. 
Mr. Sandeep Tondon, Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the respondent 
no.2. 
List this matter after service of 
notice upon the said respondent. 
Also heard on stay application. 
After considering the 
submission of the learned counsel 
for the parties and going through 
the material available on record, it is 
directed that the execution 
proceeding in pursuance of 
judgment and order dated 
07.5.2018 passed by Judge, Family 
Court, Haridwar in Case/Petition 
No.253/2014, “Smt. Sundari @ 
Tannu Chauhan vs. Vikas 
Chauhan”, under Section 125 of 
Cr.P.C., shall remain stayed 
provided revisionist pays Rs.3,500/- 
per month to the respondent no.2 
(wife) as a maintenance, on or before 
15th of every month. 
Stay application stands 
disposed of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 31.5.2018 
A.kaur
